claims.text: With \(q=n-r\), \(\lambda\subseteq q^r\iff\lambda'\subseteq r^q\); hence \(\omega(I_{r,q})=I_{q,r}\) and \(\omega:\Lambda/I_{r,q}\xrightarrow{\sim}\Lambda/I_{q,r}\) is a graded integral algebra isomorphism. This is claim-3.

The requested claim-4 would additionally require \[ \omega(J_v)=J_{v^\vee},\qquad \omega(A_{r,q,+}J_v)=A_{q,r,+}J_{v^\vee}, \] for \(v^\vee=v_{q,q+j-i,q-i+1,n}\), to induce \[ J_v/A_{r,q,+}J_v\cong J_{v^\vee}/A_{q,r,+}J_{v^\vee}. \] The audited attempt assumes, rather than establishes, the needed interval identity \[ J_v=\bigoplus_{i^j\subseteq\lambda\subseteq q^r}\mathbb Z\bar s_\lambda. \] Its cited source establishes only the lower-adjoined minimal generating family; the right-adjoined family is stated as requiring a transposed argument.
